paragraphs: AI engineer. I build intelligent systems and actually ship them — trading apps, desktop widgets, and developer tools that real people use.
features: QML + C++ · GPL-2.0+ · published on the KDE Store · Repository
A native KDE Plasma 6 widget that turns your panel into a complete AI assistant — cloud or fully offline — with voice, memory, scheduling and developer tooling built in rather than bolted on.

Cloud or fully offline — 15+ providers out of the box (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, OpenRouter, Mistral) plus local models through Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp and LiteLLM. Providers load their model lists…

Local voice mode (beta) — talk hands-free with Whisper speech-to-text and Kokoro text-to-speech running on your own machine, CPU or CUDA-accelerated. Highlight any passage and only that gets read aloud, with a global…

Background task scheduler — recurring prompts through systemd user services: cron-style schedules for daily briefings, rate checks and automated code reviews — plus a live resource monitor with per-process kill buttons.

requirements.text: Photos from anywhere — Google Drive and OneDrive via OAuth device flow (no Google Play Services needed, which is why it works on Huawei), Dropbox, self-hosted Immich, Nextcloud over WebDAV, Synology NAS or local storage — all sources can run at once and merge into one shuffled stream.
